# Designed primer pairs, one row per pair (Primer3). Tm: nearest neighbour, SantaLucia (1998) parameters and salt correction, 50 mM monovalent, 1.5 mM divalent, 0.6 mM dNTP, 50 nM primer (primer3-py 2.4.0 calc_tm). Products: with the deletion = distance between the primers across the junction; without = that plus the deletion length. design_source says which sequence each pair was designed on. Checks: primers are exact substrings of the design sequence and flank the breakpoint; products recomputed from the primer positions; in-silico PCR against --reference when given (<= 2 mismatches per primer, 3' base matching, products 60-6000 bp, at the locus = within 2500 bp of the deletion). Hairpin and dimer Tm / dG are new in BroodLink (primer3-py thermodynamic alignment), empty without primer3-py. In-silico design only: no laboratory test.
